title: rhaphiolepis poilanei
intro: Rhaphiolepis poilanei, commonly known as the Vietnamese hawthorn, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting digestive well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rhaphiolepis poilanei include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
